第二十五章 金丹对峙势均力敌（第1页）
陈默靠在木屋墙边，肩头的小白狐蜷着身子，火红眼眸半眯，看似休憩，实则也感知着四方气息。他看着眼前几位同伴各异的神态举止，又听着远方不绝的战响，心绪沉静下来。
有师尊暗中安排庇护，有筑基修士带队照看，此地虽非绝对安全，却远比前线安稳。他握紧袖中的阴魄剑，暗自打定主意，值守之余，继续打磨修为与剑术，静静等待局势演变。
夜色渐浓，山林被浓墨般的黑暗笼罩，远方战场传来的灵力轰鸣此起彼伏，破空锐响时不时划破夜空。按照值守安排，苏晚晴带着陈默沿灵田外围展开巡逻。周遭林木幽深，夜风穿过枝桠，发出沙沙轻响，四下寂静，唯有两人脚步落地的轻音。
苏晚晴周身灵力悄然延展，探查着周遭数丈之内的动静，步履平稳从容。陈默紧随其后，肩头的小白狐双耳轻颤，敏锐捕捉着林间每一丝异动。一路行来氛围安静，二人专心巡查，只在途经一片长势旺盛的灵药丛时，发现几株灵苗被夜风刮得歪斜。陈默上前俯身，小心将植株扶正，动作细致，片刻后便继续前行。
整段巡逻路途并无外人侵扰，行至灵田西侧区域，苏晚晴停下脚步，转头看向陈默，准备将当下的势力底牌与战局实情告知于他。
二人驻足在老树之下，夜色遮蔽了大半身形，隔绝了远处同伴的视线。苏晚晴神色依旧清冷，声音压得很低，缓缓道出林家如今的依仗。
“前线厮杀胶着，你我不必过分忧心。最新消息听说家族早有准备，耗费巨额灵石并让出了一座灵峰，重金聘请了两位金丹散修前来相助此二人听说是散修间的强者。不是将会写地址没人来我林家助阵。坐下我们就大可不必害怕他们了。”
陈默心中一凛。他深知境界鸿沟，金丹修士乃是如今这片地域的顶尖战力，足以左右一场世家纷争的走向。
“联军那边的战力也不容小觑。”苏晚晴继续说道，“发起争端的武家，族内有两名金丹高手坐镇；与之勾结的叶家实力稍弱，仅有一名金丹修士。”
“如今三方顶尖战力恰好形成制衡。我方两位金丹散修，刚好牵制住武家两大金丹；叶家那名金丹修士投鼠忌器，不敢贸然出手。眼下局势勉强持平，短时间内不会出现一边倒的局面。”
说完局势，她目光落在陈默身上，语气带着几分叮嘱：“韩长老临行前特意嘱咐，让我照拂于你。此地虽相对安全，但暗流涌动，巡逻值守切莫大意，安稳守好灵田便是。”
陈默拱手致谢：“多谢队长提点，晚辈明白。”随后她看了看沉默肩头的狐狸并摸了摸她的头。狐狸躲了两下，但还是被她摸了，于是便流露出了嫌弃的小表情。
陈默立马尴尬地揪了揪狐狸的毛，一边低头地一脸陪笑的对着长老说道:“弟子的灵宠生性愚笨，比较顽皮希望多多谅解”
简单交谈过后，二人再度动身，顺着蜿蜒山道，继续完成剩余的巡查路线。

Chapter 25: The confrontation between Jindan is evenly matched (page 1)
Chen Mo leaned against the wall of the wooden house, the little white fox on his shoulder curled up, his fiery red eyes half-squinted, seemingly resting, but in fact he was sensing the aura from all directions. He looked at the different expressions and behaviors of the companions in front of him, and listened to the constant sound of fighting in the distance, and his mind calmed down.
The master secretly arranges shelter, and the foundation-building monks lead a team to look after them. Although this place is not absolutely safe, it is far safer than the front line. He grasped the Yin Po Sword tightly in his sleeve and secretly made up his mind. While on duty, he continued to hone his cultivation and swordsmanship, and quietly waited for the situation to evolve.
The night is getting darker, and the mountain forest is shrouded in thick ink-like darkness. The roar of spiritual power from the distant battlefield comes one after another, and the sharp sound pierces the night sky from time to time. According to the duty arrangement, Su Wanqing led Chen Mo to patrol along the periphery of Lingtian. The surrounding trees were deep and dark, and the night wind passed through the branches, making a soft rustling sound. There was silence everywhere except for the soft sound of the two people's footsteps falling to the ground.
Su Wanqing's spiritual power spread quietly throughout her body, exploring the movements within a few feet of her surroundings, walking steadily and calmly. Chen Mo followed closely behind, the ears of the little white fox on his shoulder trembling slightly, keenly catching every movement in the forest. The atmosphere was quiet along the way, and the two of them concentrated on patrolling. Only when passing by a vigorously growing elixir bush, they discovered that several spiritual seedlings were blown askew by the night wind. Chen Mo stepped forward and leaned over, carefully straightening the plant with meticulous movements, and then continued moving forward after a moment.
There was no intrusion from outsiders during the entire patrol. When they reached the west side of Lingtian, Su Wanqing stopped and turned to look at Chen Mo, preparing to tell him the current trump cards and the actual situation of the battle.
The two of them stopped under the old tree. The night covered most of their bodies, cutting off the sight of their companions in the distance. Su Wanqing's expression remained cold, her voice was very low, and she slowly revealed the Lin family's current reliance.
"We are fighting on the front line, so you and I don't need to worry too much. The latest news is that the family has been prepared for a long time. They spent a huge amount of spiritual stones and gave up a spiritual peak. They paid a lot of money to hire two Jindan cultivators to come to help. I heard that these two people are strong among the cultivators. No one will come to my Lin family to help if I don't write the address. We don't have to be afraid of them when we sit down."
Chen Mo's heart trembled. He is well aware of the gap between realms. Golden elixir monks are now the top combat force in this area, and they are enough to influence the direction of a family dispute.
"The combat power of the coalition forces should not be underestimated." Su Wanqing continued, "The Wu family that initiated the dispute has two golden elixir masters in the family; the Ye family who colluded with them is slightly weaker and only has one golden elixir monk."
"Now the top combat forces of the three parties have just formed a check and balance. Our two golden elixir monks have just restrained the two major golden elixirs of the Wu family; the golden elixir cultivator of the Ye family is afraid of taking action rashly. The situation is barely balanced at the moment, and there will be no one-sided situation in the short term."
After talking about the situation, her eyes fell on Chen Mo, and her tone was a bit warning: "Elder Han specifically asked me to take care of you before leaving. Although this place is relatively safe, there are undercurrents. Don't be careless when patrolling, just keep the spiritual field safe."
Chen Mo raised his hands and thanked him: "Thank you, captain, for your advice. I understand." Then she looked at the fox on Mo Mo's shoulder and touched her head. The fox hid twice, but was still touched by her, so he showed a disgusted expression.
Chen Mo immediately tugged on the fox's fur in embarrassment, lowered his head and said to the elder with a smile on his face: "My disciple's spiritual pet is stupid by nature and is rather naughty. I hope you can forgive me."
After a brief conversation, the two set off again, following the winding mountain road to complete the remaining patrol route.
